items.title: 67250_John Collins oral history interview
items.q: Duke Ellington's band. This was a great band, this particular band was a great band. And this was -- band was Louie Bellson, Wendell Marshall, I believe, Shorty Baker, Cooke, what's his name.

ctx.x: You were saying earlier that someone who you recorded with wasn't stimulating musically. Who were some that you recorded with of the most stimulating people, musically, (inaudible).

Well, I was telling you about one recording I did with Ella Fitzgerald about -- I guess about two years ago. This was a unique, unusual record in that we did 30 tunes on one side, and we segued from one tune to another, never a break, just a direct segue. And it was a beautiful album. Benny Carter was the leader, and it was Georgie Auld, Edison Georgia All, Harry Sweets Addison, and Louie Bellson. We had a bass player, Bob West. Did I say Jimmie Jones was playing piano? Yeah, Jimmie Jones was playing piano. And I…
mind me about the last names because I --
